semanticProfile.description: Optional compact relationship evidence for semantic grouping. It is derived from the card's actual data configuration, contains no business-dimension whitelist, and must not be inferred from the title.

maxRows.description: Maximum sample rows returned per Widget in this response. It only truncates the response; it does not change or prove the Widget's own query limit. Verify configuration with dashboard.get_widget_config effectiveSpec, not with the number of rows returned here.

includeMetadata.description: Defaults to true. Each Widget item then carries metadata.rowCount (rows the page holds for that Widget before truncation) and metadata.returnedRowCount (rows in this response, capped by maxRows). Pass false to omit metadata.

group.description: Actual native series grouping; null means unconfigured. Missing group, dimensions or rowCount alone do not prove grouping.

effectiveSpec.description: Same shape as dashboard.apply_widget_spec's data.appliedSpec (chartType, title, dataset, metrics, dimensions, group, filters, sort, limit, comparison), produced by the same summarizer. Present for data Widgets only. group reports native series configuration; require enabled:true and the intended fieldId to confirm grouping. limit is non-null only for Leaderboard 11001.

widgets.description: Present only when widgetIds was used. One entry per requested Widget, in request order.

group.description: Actual native series grouping; null means unconfigured. Missing group, dimensions or rowCount alone do not prove grouping.

refs.description: Read-only metadata references; never copy refs into effectiveSpec or apply_widget_spec. Unresolved fields have a reason instead of a guessed fieldRef.
Read-only metadata references; never copy refs into effectiveSpec or apply_widget_spec. Unresolved fields have a reason instead of a guessed fieldRef.

sections.description: Return only capabilities in these sections. Omit for all sections.

includeCreationOptions.description: Defaults to false. Set true only when you need the Widget creation catalog (dashboard.add_widget).

orderedWidgetIds.description: Required for reorder: every EFFECTIVE root Widget ID exactly once. For 3A/3B/3C, regroup removes every existing native flat container and orderedWidgetIds contains all released flat children plus current non-container roots and preserved Tab roots, excluding removed flat containers. Tab containers and their children remain outside the root order and keep ownership. Runtime checks complete effective order and structural membership/contiguity, not semantic classification or whether every root is grouped. The model performs one topicKey/stageRank pass and never revisits a completed classification.

scopeOrders.description: Optional complete orders for existing native flat/Tab scopes. When supplied, include every existing nonempty layout scope exactly once. Each orderedWidgetIds is the complete direct-child permutation for that scope; ownership never changes. Flat scopes are compacted with Function 2 and their container height may change to fit the result. Tab child order remains native Tab order. All scope and root changes are saved atomically.

groups.description: Optional nonempty native flat groups. Choosing 3A/3B/3C authorizes full semantic regrouping: remove every existing native flat container, preserve Tabs, and classify released flat children and current roots in one topicKey/stageRank pass. Derive membership from each card's compact data-configuration profile and actual card type, including dataset, dimensions, metrics, aggregation, filters, time grain, grouping and drill relationships. Never use a business-dimension whitelist, title similarity, stage name or numeric card limit to decide membership. stageRank orders the reading flow but is not a mandatory group boundary. Do not ask whether to create groups, whether to preserve old flat groups, or for a second regroup confirmation. Members are unique across groups and contiguous in orderedWidgetIds; uncertain relationships use the single bounded ambiguity pass. Preserve every card ID, data and non-layout config in one atomic transaction; no per-card add/delete/copy/move or whole-dashboard overwrite.

comparisonPairs.description: Optional approved same-row comparison relations between non-metric cards. Each pair contains two adjacent IDs in this group's widgetIds, in that order; IDs cannot occur in multiple pairs. Establish matching metric, time and filter semantics from configuration, show pairs in the proposal, then obtain authorization. Runtime does not infer business meaning. Prefer keeping each pair on one row when readable sizes and explicit locks permit; otherwise preserve content and order and report LAYOUT_COMPARISON_STACKED, not execution failure. Never shrink fonts, remove cards or override locked dimensions to force a pair.

groupingConfirmed.description: When true, attests that Choosing 3A/3B/3C authorizes full semantic regrouping without a second regroup or exact-proposal confirmation. The model chooses one final set of titles and members in a single topicKey/stageRank pass. Each group contains at least two related effective roots; an explicit only-reorder/no-grouping request omits groups, groupingConfirmed and regroup.

regroup.description: For 3A/3B/3C, removes every existing native flat container before replacement grouping. Tab containers are excluded from removal and keep their members. Choosing option 3 authorizes this regroup for the intended save; Do not ask for a second regroup confirmation or exact-proposal approval. Requires groups, groupingConfirmed:true, reorder and expectedResourceRevision. Every released flat child ID, data and non-layout config stays unchanged. Removal, promotion, replacement grouping, Function 2 compact planning and persistence are one atomic transaction.

containerWidgetIds.description: Every existing native flat container Widget ID exactly once, not card UIDs or child IDs. Tab containers are excluded from removal. Identify containers by actual chartType, never title. The model derives this list mechanically from the complete structure and does not debate or request confirmation for individual IDs.

confirmed.description: Attests that the 3A/3B/3C choice authorizes removal of all existing native flat containers and creation of the single-pass replacement groups for the intended operation. No second exact-proposal confirmation is required. A dryRun preview still does not authorize a later save; the user must explicitly request saving after preview.

sizing.description: preserve locks sizes unless explicitly overridden. content sizes eligible cards from measured content; auto tries preserved sizes then content within one call. Without regroup old container children remain unchanged. During regroup unaffected roots may reposition x/y with size, config and children unchanged; only approved grouping cards may change size/ownership, preserving IDs, data and non-layout config. Ordinary measurement failures retain sizes with warnings; insufficient grouped-content evidence stops grouping before writing. No repeated model calls. For ordinary compact/reorder final root rows with automatic content sizing only; align retains original columns. Use existing mixed packing first: try useful compatible other cards while preserving reading order and group boundaries. If no suitable other card fills the blank, an isolated row with at least two automatic metrics fills the whole available row width on the integer 24-column grid: equal when divisible, otherwise integer widths differ by at most one grid unit. Use equal height: the smallest measured fitting common height within the bounded probe, never exceeding the original compact row maximum height; not a global minimum-height guarantee. If none fits, retain the compact row. At assigned widths, measure both assigned widths and common height; preserve gaps and padding. A single metric stays compact; fallback leaves single metrics and explicit sizes unchanged. Locks: explicit preserve and size locks take priority; rankings stay narrow/tall; IDs, data and non-layout config remain unchanged. Fallback is disabled during approved grouping's temporary root sizing preview (capturePlan); existing and new group inner layouts are unaffected. It does not resize existing containers or normalize their children; existing container membership remains protected. capturePlan is internal, not a tool field. Same call; no new fields, model coordinates or order/group changes. If unmeasurable or locked, preserve constraints and report limitations.

dryRun.description: Return computed layout without saving. An explicit user request to preview the exact shown proposal may attest groupingConfirmed/regroup.confirmed for dryRun:true only, without prior save approval. Later writing requires explicit save approval even for the same proposal. Changed scope or membership requires renewed authorization. Do not reject a legitimate preview-then-decide request or silently save after preview.

query.description: Field search by default; with fieldId, searches actual enum labels/values using the user's business term.

fieldId.description: Select enum lookup for this exact authorized dataset field; works before creating a Widget.

sourceUid.description: Disambiguate a field present in multiple dataset sources.

dimensions.description: For native group-capable bar/line/area charts, dimensions[0] is the X axis and dimensions[1] is the series group; two dimensions require exactly one metric. Other non-table/pivot charts accept at most one dimension. Table/pivot retain column semantics. Unsupported shapes return CHART_SHAPE_INVALID before writing.

filters.description: Use the metric's business date; do not add an unrelated date window. For enum equality/membership, use exact values/types from dashboard.get_filter_field_options. Native verification runs before dryRun/writes; ENUM_VALUE_UNVERIFIED blocks guesses even with source=tool_verified.

operator.description: Use operator=eq with valueExp. For a fixed range, use operator=between with exactly two literal values.

value.description: Literal filter values. operator=between without valueExp requires exactly two entries; last_days requires ["N"], and last_xy_days requires ["X", "Y"].

valueExp.description: Relative time shortcut. Use operator=eq. last_days takes value ["N"]; last_xy_days takes ["X", "Y"]; the other shortcuts take no value.

source.description: Provenance of this filter's value. user_stated: the user's own words; user_confirmed: the user picked it when asked; tool_verified: backed by catalog/schema/readback evidence. assumed is rejected with NEEDS_USER_CLARIFICATION before any persistent write - ask the user instead of guessing (dryRun probes may pass assumed).

sort.description: For grouped charts, sort by the X-axis field or a metric. Sorting by the series group field is unsupported and returns CHART_SHAPE_INVALID.

limit.description: Row cap (Top N) for Leaderboard widgets only (chartType 11001). Any other chartType returns LIMIT_NOT_SUPPORTED without writing; bar/line/pie/table have no Top N.

comparison.description: Metric-card comparison settings. Omit this property to preserve an existing valid comparison. Omission disables a stale comparison whose time field is no longer present in filters, and prunes methods that become incompatible after its time expression changes.

method.description: Comparison period: dayChain=日环比, weekSame=周同比, monthChain=月环比, yearSame=年同比.

calcType.description: Comparison calculation: diffRate=差异率, diff=差值.

group.description: Actual native series grouping; null means unconfigured. Missing group, dimensions or rowCount alone do not prove grouping.

probe.description: Row probe for the written or dry-run spec. On persistent writes it is the real first query of the persisted widget: rowCount 0 means the query ran and returned nothing; unavailableReason means the probe could not run and the receipt is partial — nothing is proven about the data. rowCount proves query data only, not chart series grouping; verify appliedSpec.group.

sampleRows.description: 按维度分组时每行的维度取值（按 fieldId 建键），即该字段在当前口径下实际有哪些值。想知道某个筛选值写得对不对，就把该字段放进 dimensions 试跑一次。

exhaustive.description: Upstream enum search is bounded; absence is not proof that a value does not exist.

removedContainerWidgetIds.description: Actual explicitly approved old container Widget IDs removed by a confirmed saved regroup transaction. In a dry-run preview these are proposed removals only, not proof of deletion. Omitted or empty when no old containers are removed. Every original non-container child ID, data and non-layout config is preserved.

executionMode.description: Layout execution path for compact or organize preset. remote means AgentHost solved the layout; linear_fallback means the frontend sequential compact fallback was used.

layoutRunId.description: Last backend layout computation ID for protected diagnostic lookup.

layoutRunIds.description: Backend computation IDs in execution order, including content-repair attempts.

remoteStatus.description: Remote solver status when executionMode is linear_fallback, for example service_unavailable, budget_exhausted, search_exhausted, invalid_response, or content_verification_failed.

fallbackReason.description: Why compact or organize layout fell back to the frontend linear algorithm.

contentFit.description: Metric candidate sizing evidence before explicit overrides: hidden DOM copies were tested with the renderer font rules. Not a post-save visual check or a global optimum guarantee.

requestedOrderApplied.description: Present for reorder mode: final native geometry follows the requested ID order. With preview:true this describes the preview only; persisted indicates whether a save occurred.

orderedScopeWidgetIds.description: Existing flat/Tab layout Widget IDs whose complete direct-child orders were applied in this atomic reorder.

layoutQuality.description: Audit of final row-aware canvas geometry. Distinguishes interior holes, row tails, unequal bottoms and staggered row starts. Nonzero gaps or unprobed metrics prevent a no-waste claim; this is not visual verification.

largestEmptyRectangle.description: Largest empty rectangle diagnostic. A connected blank region may be larger than any rectangle; inspect largestConnectedGapCells as well. Grid gutters are excluded.

candidateSearchConverged.description: The bounded row planner completed under current content/order constraints. Does not mean zero external gaps, post-render remeasurement or globally minimal card sizes.

committed.description: Whether the backend transaction is known to have committed even when the frontend cannot safely accept or verify the returned state.

dashboard.get_structure.description: Read a structured, version-bound page of the current dashboard hierarchy and layout. Data cards include a compact semanticProfile derived from actual dataset, field-role, aggregation, filter, time, grouping and drill configuration; use it for relationship planning without title or business-dimension whitelists. pageSize defaults to 100; use nextCursor until hasMore is false. summary is retained for compact orientation. Pass expectedResourceRevision when continuing a repair. The response identifies root and container coordinate spaces; never infer nested widgets as root-canvas items.

dataset.marketplace.search.description: Search the dataset marketplace by business words and optional filters and return a page of datasets with their datasetRef (type:id). Read-only: it does not change the list the user sees. Use datasetRef with dataset.marketplace.get_detail, dataset.editor.open and the davinci_data tools; for ranked field-level discovery use davinci_data catalog.search_datasets.

dataset.editor.open.description: Create or open a custom dataset editor. mode edit needs a selfBuiltDataset datasetRef whose get_detail canEdit is true. If the editor is already open, read dataset.editor.get_context and reuse its draft; do not close or discard unsaved work to reopen it.

dataset.editor.get_context.description: Read the complete bounded native dataset draft, validation and draftRevision. Use this revision for apply_draft, preview, save_draft and close; preserve every source, field and filter when replacing the draft. Returned fieldIds are actual selections; requested fieldIds are not proof of an update. After uncertain outcomes read this context before reporting completion.

dataset.editor.get_join_candidates.description: Read authoritative native backend common-dimension join candidates for a main/auxiliary source pair before applying a draft. Reuse discovered main fieldIds and the intended filters, including required query variables. Unique pairs can be selected directly; ambiguous groups require a semantically justified pairing. Returns no draft mutation. If truncated, refine the main fields and query again; never invent keys.

dataset.editor.validate.description: Validate the current native draft fields, filters and joins, returning the complete context and validation issues without saving. A successful tool envelope may contain validation.valid=false; only validation.valid=true proves this draft passed.

dataset.editor.preview.description: Run the native preview for the exact expectedDraftRevision and return bounded column names, rowCount and summary. This does not save the dataset.

dataset.editor.close.description: Close the current editor at expectedDraftRevision. A dirty draft requires discardChanges=true explicitly authorized by the user; otherwise the tool refuses to discard it.

dashboard.capture_current_view.description: Read a bounded aggregate of the current Dashboard Widget cache. Partial Widget failures remain available and Artifact storage is optional overflow only.

dashboard.get_widget_data.description: Read bounded rows and metadata for selected Widgets on the open Dashboard. Optionally wait for the current frontend query generation to settle before reading once.

dashboard.get_widget_config.description: Read Widget configuration and read-only refs (datasetRef plus fieldRefs) for Data MCP metadata lookup. Unresolved fields carry unresolvedReason; never copy refs into write spec. Pass widgetId for one Widget (summary + effectiveSpec), or widgetIds (max 30) to read several in one call and get data.widgets[] in request order. effectiveSpec is the authority for configured dataset, metrics, dimensions, group, filters, sort, Leaderboard-only limit and comparison; require group.enabled:true and the intended fieldId to confirm series grouping. It does not prove query data is loaded.

dashboard.refresh_all.description: Refresh all readable Widgets on the current Dashboard and, by default, wait for the frontend query lifecycle to settle. waitUntilSettled defaults to true and timeoutMs defaults to 60000.

dashboard.refresh_widget.description: Refresh one Widget on the current Dashboard and, by default, wait only for that Widget query lifecycle to settle. waitUntilSettled defaults to true and timeoutMs defaults to 60000.

dashboard.set_widget_layout.description: Pack up to 200 roots in one frontend call. Organize preset:{mode:organize,sizing:content}: align and reduce avoidable blanks using bounded candidates, without a global optimum guarantee. Compact: preset:{mode:compact,sizing:content}. Organize/compact/align need no structure reads or model coordinates. For business reorder (3A/3B/3C), read the complete structure once, remove every existing native flat container while preserving Tabs, and classify released flat children plus current roots in one topicKey/stageRank pass. Generate one final semantic order and replacement group set without showing candidates or asking a second grouping/regroup question. An explicit 'only reorder/no grouping' request uses non-destructive ordinary reorder. Pass mode:reorder, all effective-root orderedWidgetIds and expectedResourceRevision. content sizes supported roots from measured metric shapes and chart policies; auto first tries preserved sizes and repairs a failed layout baseline within the same call. preserve locks sizes and align retains x columns. Explicit sizeOverrides/typeSizes remain hard constraints. Without regroup, root planning preserves existing flat/Tab ownership and child geometry; hidden or unmeasurable content is preserved and reported, not claimed optimized. Only user-visible cards in resolvable root, flat or active Tab scopes count as layout cards. Inactive Tab pages, framework placeholders and hidden nodes whose parent no longer resolves are preserved unchanged but excluded from solving and visual acceptance; they never block unrelated visible scopes and are never surfaced as cards the user must find, edit or delete. A Tab must not disable content sizing for unrelated roots. Complete row and mixed-height region candidates are compared after final geometry adjustments. For ordinary compact/reorder final root rows with automatic content sizing only; align retains original columns. Use existing mixed packing first: try useful compatible other cards while preserving reading order and group boundaries. If no suitable other card fills the blank, an isolated row with at least two automatic metrics fills the whole available row width on the integer 24-column grid: equal when divisible, otherwise integer widths differ by at most one grid unit. Use equal height: the smallest measured fitting common height within the bounded probe, never exceeding the original compact row maximum height; not a global minimum-height guarantee. If none fits, retain the compact row. At assigned widths, measure both assigned widths and common height; preserve gaps and padding. A single metric stays compact; fallback leaves single metrics and explicit sizes unchanged. Locks: explicit preserve and size locks take priority; rankings stay narrow/tall; IDs, data and non-layout config remain unchanged. Fallback is disabled during approved grouping's temporary root sizing preview (capturePlan), without root-row expansion inflating group height. For existing containers outside approved regroup, it does not resize existing containers or normalize their children; existing container membership remains protected. capturePlan is internal. Preserve constraints and report unmeasurable content. Automatic leaderboard width stays narrow and height accounts for the canvas pixel aspect ratio. Ordinary charts may retain some original height into vacant space without exceeding it. In automatic content sizing, Table/PivotTable may widen while retaining existing height and explicit width/height locks; tables are not split. Bounds, overlaps, complete IDs, reading order and container height remain validation requirements. Empty-space and leaderboard-shape metrics are advisory quality signals, never reasons to reject otherwise valid final geometry. Automatic sizing still targets narrow portrait rankings; explicit size locks take priority with a shape warning if needed. A content-measurement exception falls back to preserved sizes inside the same call. Remaining space is reported as LAYOUT_REMAINING_SPACE on a successful result, including connected regions of 9 or more cells. Quality warnings are not failures; do not ask users to change mode/order to resolve them. Report permission, stale-resource, invalid-input and persistence failures. Do not retry with another mode, guessed dimensions or call. constraints.solverFinal:true means this call ended, not that a Host solver ran. Report receipts; never infer unsaved-candidate causes or propose deletion/reordering without evidence. Save geometry and layout policy together at most once. Check persisted, preview, requestedOrderApplied, summary.contentFit and issues; disclose externalGapCells and skipped sizing. Staggered rows and misalignedBlockCount are diagnostic, not vetoes. Geometry/synthetic tests prove neither visual acceptance nor the 30-second end-to-end target. A timed-out dispatched save has unknown outcome, not proven rollback. An explicit request to preview the option-3 result may attest groupingConfirmed/regroup.confirmed for dryRun:true only; later writing requires explicit save approval even for the same proposal. Do not reject legitimate preview-then-decide requests or carry preview authorization into a write. Legacy items (max 30) is for explicit manual edits, not beautification fallback. Choosing 3A/3B/3C authorizes full semantic regrouping and groupingConfirmed:true for the intended operation. Optional preset.groups creates replacement native flat containers of at least two related cards. Include every existing native flat container Widget ID in regroup.containerWidgetIds and exclude every Tab. Do not ask whether to create groups, whether to preserve old flat groups, or for a second regroup or exact-proposal confirmation. Only an explicit 'only reorder/no grouping' request omits groups and regroup. Classify containers and cards by actual chartType, never title alone. Without regroup, existing flat/Tab containers and their children remain protected and cannot be moved into new groups. Optional preset.regroup requires groups, groupingConfirmed:true and mode:reorder; expectedResourceRevision is mandatory. Derive the complete old-flat removal list mechanically from chartType, preserve every Tab and every non-container card ID, data and non-layout config, then write once without revisiting classification. Keep orderedWidgetIds complete and group members contiguous. Perform removal, promotion, compact planning, outer-frame normalization and persistence atomically; never retry by excluding hidden or protected children. For new outer groups, one group occupies 24 columns; two consecutive lightweight narrow-card groups may occupy 12 columns each when both exact compact results fit and have equal height; otherwise each group occupies 24 columns. Three or more groups never share one row. Preserve inner locks and measured content evidence, require final DOM validation, and report actual grouping/removal receipts. No publish.

dashboard.add_widget.description: Create and persist one empty widget of a chartType advertised by dashboard.get_widget_edit_capabilities creationOptions. Use only for message widgets or when the user wants an unconfigured card; for a data widget use dashboard.apply_widget_spec with create, which configures and persists in one call.

dashboard.copy_widget.description: Copy and persist one existing Widget, preserving its native Davinci configuration and layout relationships.

dashboard.rename_widget.description: Rename one existing widget and persist. Equivalent to apply_widget_spec spec.title when other configuration also changes.

toolAdditions.description: Get one native source field page and its query variables. Ordinary filters use fieldId from fields. Only widget sources expose usable queryVars: set isQueryVar=true only for an exact returned variable. Required date fields are ordinary filters unless returned as queryVars. Ask for missing date ranges before apply_draft. Query variables cannot be output or join fields; private enum configuration is not exposed.

Atomically replace full draft sources, selected fields, filters, main source and joins at expectedDraftRevision. Read get_context and get_source_fields first; preserve unrelated data because omitted fields/sources/filters are removed. Ordinary filters use fields; only exact widget queryVars may set isQueryVar=true. Supply complete required dates. Metadata is optional. Every auxiliary needs a native-authorized dimension join with selected main keys. Does not save. Only successful returned sources prove selected fields; only validation.valid=true proves validation. committed=false means the replacement did not take effect; never claim its fields were selected. Read get_context if the outcome is uncertain.

Validate the exact expectedDraftRevision and open the native prefilled save dialog for user confirmation. A successful status opened means only that confirmation is visible, never that the dataset was saved; actual native save still requires the user. Set metadata through apply_draft first.

Create one named group under the personal workspace Dashboard V2 menu. The name is trimmed and must contain 1 to 20 characters. This is unavailable in collaborative spaces and never returns an internal group id.

Create an empty personal V2 dashboard in a uniquely named current personal group, or ungrouped if groupName is omitted. Open it and wait for navigation before adding widgets. A created partial outcome must not be replayed.

Describe bounded editable capabilities and current values for selected Widgets, or all Widgets when widgetIds is omitted. Use sections to return only the capability groups needed. Set includeCreationOptions true only before dashboard.add_widget, and includeDatasetOptions true only before dashboard.set_widget_dataset.

Prefer a preset for whole-dashboard colors (up to 50 Widgets): A is theme:plain; B1 is theme:colorful with variant:metric-unified; B2 is theme:colorful with variant:metric-multicolor. Repeated built-in B1 or B2 calls advance through ranked palettes; explicit colors bypass built-in selection. The schema bounds colors syntactically as unique six-digit hex values; the frontend rejects low-contrast colors and rejects theme:plain combined with variant or colors. Supported non-metric analysis cards in scope normalize to white. If no applicable metric cards exist, return persisted:false without saving. Legacy theme:colorful calls without variant map to B2 metric-multicolor. Frontend resolves capabilities, skips unchanged or unsupported colors and saves once: no get_structure, capabilities read or per-widget operations needed. Default scope is background. For custom edits pass operations from capabilities instead. Returns persisted, appliedCount, skippedWidgetIds and optional palette receipt fields. A theme preset emits LAYOUT_BASELINE_REQUIRED when the rendered root layout contains large empty space or a wide/flat leaderboard, including on unchanged colors. Follow with one compact sizing:auto layout preset (preserve when sizes are explicitly locked) to repair geometry before claiming whole-dashboard completion; honor explicit position/size locks and report conflicts. Version guard applies. For data bindings use apply_widget_spec.
Request deletion of one Widget. Davinci presents an explicit browser confirmation and persists only after the user confirms; deleteChildren controls layout-child handling.
Switch one Widget to an available dataset using Davinci's native reset and dependency-cleanup semantics, then persist the complete change.

Atomically configure one Widget (widgetId or create) with verified fields and comparison; limit is Leaderboard 11001 only. required=true is mandatory; requiredCondition seeds a default. Use the metric's business date; another valid date filter satisfies time requirements. For enum equality/membership, use exact values/types from dashboard.get_filter_field_options; native verification rejects guesses. Group-capable bar/line/area charts use dimensions[0] as X, dimensions[1] as series with one metric. Confirm appliedSpec.group.enabled/fieldId, not rowCount. dryRun does not write. Writes preserve styles and return appliedSpec/resourceRevision.
Read current publish state and structured blockers from the same validation rules used by Davinci's publish action.

Publish the current dashboard through Davinci's native publish workflow. Allowed only when the user asked to publish in this turn; never use it to verify a write. Returns published or publishing truthfully.

Read filter fields/operators, or verify actual enum values before configuring a filter. With datasetUid, datasetType and fieldId, query searches the native enum API and returns enumValues.items with label and exact stored value; works before a Widget uses the dataset. Use this for business terms such as delivery method/status, independently of catalog search budget. Write the returned value preserving its type, not the display label or a guess from descriptions. Multiple plausible choices require clarification. Results are bounded; empty/truncated results do not prove absence. cursor/limit page the returned candidates (default 20 values, max 100); omit fieldId for existing field metadata pagination.
Atomically validate and persist a bounded batch of global filter upserts and removals against current field metadata.
Move one non-layout Widget into a flat or tab layout, or back to the root canvas when containerWidgetId is null, using native layout semantics.
Persist the complete child order of a tab layout after validating that every current child appears exactly once.

List a page of collaborative spaces visible to the current user (name, type, role, canOpen) and return the opaque spaceRef required by space.open and space.update_info. Refs are valid until the page navigates or the list is read again.
Read the current collaborative-space page, trusted space scope, role, lifecycle state and available management capabilities.

Open a listed collaborative space. Use destination=subscription when the user requests a space-owned subscription, including from a Dashboard. Waits for that center to be ready and verifies target management permission; omission opens the native default page, which may be a Dashboard with personal-only subscription shortcuts.
Create a team space immediately, or show native confirmation before submitting organization creation approval. Pending approval is not a usable space.
Rename a listed owner space directly without navigation. Omitted description preserves its current value; an explicit empty description clears it.
Read up to 10 listed spaces without navigation, 20 members per page. Target owner/admin only; follow hasMore and never treat forbidden or error as an empty list. Member refs are bound to their space.

Transfer a listed space to an explicitly selected joined member after native user confirmation. Owner only. Keep the reviewed retained role; unknown outcome requires checking current owner before retry.
Soft-delete a listed space or submit organization deletion approval after native user confirmation. Owner only; never permanently deletes. Pending approval is not deletion.
Submit a team space upgrade to a uniquely named department after native user confirmation. Owner only. Pending approval is not a completed upgrade.
Accept or decline one current pending collaborative-space invitation by an opaque invitation reference.
Read a bounded member page or search invitation candidates in the current trusted space, returning opaque member references.

Apply exactly one member change in the current trusted space using refs from space.member.get_context: invite (candidateRefs from invite_candidates searches, all still valid in this page), set_role or remove (memberRef). INVALID_ARGUMENT names the ref that is no longer valid.
Read the bounded business-directory and function-page tree for the current trusted space with opaque menu references.

Apply one menu operation in the current trusted space: create_group (receipt targetRef is the new groupRef for space.dashboard.create_and_open), update (itemRef, name), confirmed delete (itemRef) or complete reorder (groups). To create a dashboard use space.dashboard.create_and_open; create_page returns ACTION_REPLACED.
Create one Dashboard function page in the current manageable space, open it, and return only after the new Dashboard page is ready.
Open the collaborative-space home page. This only navigates; it does not create, update, delete, transfer or manage space members.
Open the current user's personal workspace home. This leaves collaborative-space scope and accepts no route or resource arguments.

Read current ownership, active native configuration, permissions, locks, revisions, queries and real outputs. This tool is read-only: it does not accept business intake or execute configuration. Use start_draft for a new form and apply_draft for changes to an active form. requiredContentFields comes from native validation. rulesIncluded=false means history was not read. Reuse actual source, field and output refs; do not re-search confirmed resources. Never preview, save or enable.

Search subscription-eligible candidates with trusted refs. For dynamic employees use kind=field to read isEmployeeAccount and employeeAccountType (oa/ob), never ask users to identify stored account types. Use enum_value for status choices and requiresTimeFilter for query dates. Field queries accept | to combine terms. Catalog MCP results locate data but do not establish subscription eligibility. truncated is not an exhaustive list. kind=widget lists embeddable content only and excludes some metric cards. For alert data sources use kind=alert_widget scoped by dashboardRef, then start_draft(mode=widget,widgetRef). Missing content widgets never authorizes a global dataset search.

Open one shared editable subscription form and wait for acknowledgement; opening does not save. Navigate to the requested ownership first. Reuse an active form. mode=widget imports the selected alert_widget native template; the current-page bell supplies live global filters. Open early with known independent operations. Blank missing titles and rule names receive editable native defaults; explicit input, template locks and existing values win. Retain the real source/template seed and reconcile its editable defaults with the user request. Use ordered components for content. Batch resolved query/output dependencies. presentation describes the actual step. finish=true validates the written revision and returns the manual preview/save handoff; structural readiness does not prove all user requirements were included.

Apply one atomic batch to the current native form using its actual expectedRevision. Preserve unrelated settings and user edits. bind_dataset_query verifies exact catalog refs. queryKey/outputKey provide same-batch local refs; across calls use returned queryRef/outputRef. Use ordered components for content and patch_content for block edits. Add comparisons with metricsMode=merge; keep base outputs and unrelated filters. all push mode normalizes to mode only. A successful unchanged write keeps the same revision. First-revision missing titles/names receive editable defaults only when not explicit or locked. presentation describes the actual step. finish=true checks this revision and returns completion; ready hands off manual preview/save without another review. Do not rebuild a task or change sources to recover a field error.

Review the current native configuration with the same server checks as create, without persistence or delivery. includeDataCheck defaults to false; the configuration Agent must leave data verification to the user Send Preview action. Compare actual configuration with the user request before finish=true. finish returns the same completion as start/apply: ready means configuration validation passed, saved=false and dataVerified=false. Do not repeat after a current ready completion.
Unavailable to the subscription configuration Agent. The user previews and saves manually in the native editor.
Open a data-alert draft for one eligible widget (ids listed in the dashboard_structure context item) using the same eligibility and template workflow as the alert bell. This does not persist a rule.

Change only what the user sees, never configuration or data: focus a widget, open or close the widget configuration panel or the global filter panel, enter or leave presentation mode, or open the share panel. Call it only when the user explicitly asks to show, open, focus or go fullscreen; to change a widget use dashboard.apply_widget_spec instead. widgetId is required for widget_focus and widget_config.

Get one dataset's full detail by the datasetRef (type:id) returned from dataset.marketplace.search. Returns name, description, owner, field count and canEdit; canEdit is true only when the current user created or owns this self-built dataset. Use dataset.editor.open next when canEdit is true and the user wants to edit it.

Discover authoritative join dimensions and native cardinality for two exact dataset names. Available in marketplace and editor; never opens or changes the editor. Same-name matches or incomplete search return candidates: confirm exact datasetRefs rather than choosing the first. Optional mainFieldIds narrow the main grain (maximum 100); optional joinKeys select a verified pair combination. By default all unambiguous unique pairs form one composite key. Ambiguous dimensions require explicit pairing. mainFilters/auxFilters support only widget query variables, never ordinary row filters. Report relation direction main-to-aux and its selected-main/all-aux dimension scope; this is not raw-row uniqueness. Missing parameters, failed or incomplete cardinality yield unknown, never infer 1:1 from names. See analysis.issues and truncated.
